subject: Re: Kickoff: cold posteriors & calibrated serving
body:
Hi Zofia,

Staffing: Umar Costa leads at 50%, Paloma Castillo 40% on the SG-MCMC harness, Nikhil Abebe 25% on eval plumbing.

Compute: the chains are the cost, as you guessed — long sampling runs with many parallel chains to hit the ESS targets. Plan is titan-a100 best-effort through June for development, then the big final sweeps on Cirrus: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-07-06, 128 accelerators, which covers the full temperature grid across both ResNet and LSTM experiments in one shot. That lands two weeks before your 7/17 memo date, with slack for reruns.

One flag: Paloma is also carrying harness maintenance for two other teams, so if her 40% erodes, the harness milestone slips first.

Ivo
